- AWS asks: ARR band, target launch quarter, primary technical contact + expected QPS, and brief architecture overview (single-tenant or multi-tenant).

Next steps I propose:
1) You drop the draft SOW and a 30–60s technical summary (one paragraph) — we’ll attach to the ACE form.
2) Kimberly will introduce the PDM/PSM and schedule a 30 min handshake next week.

Proposed slots: Tue 8/8 10:00–10:30 PT, Wed 8/9 13:00–13:30 PT. Let me know which works.

Hi Priya — looping in Marissa (Solutions PDM) and me for ACE. For clarity:

- PDM: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.com) — leads solution fit, willown AWS technical briefing.
- PSM: I’ll nominate Arman Gupta (internal PSM) to be your day-to-day operational contact once ACE is live — I will introduce him in the handshake meeting.

What AWS tends to validate during ACE registration: estimated ARR band (0–500k / 500k–2M / 2M+), go-to-market plan (co-marketing spend or lead sharing), and a technical contact able to answer infra deployment questions. If you can indicate ARR band + target GA quarter that helps.

If you prefer, we can submit the ACE intake while you complete the SOW — AWS will accept the registration with placeholders and a follow-up linkage to the SOW. I’ll prepare the ACE registration draft this afternoon and share the HubSpot deal link so we all have the right record.

Thanks — Kim
